title: Drill record
description: One flat JSON document per drill (build-spec §6.6). Deliberately boring: every field is either a measurement or a reference to one, never an assertion typed by a human at drill time.

controls.description: Article/control IDs this drill produces evidence for, e.g. DORA-Art11

measured_rpo_records_lost.description: max(counter) before fault - max(counter) after restore, from the canary

recovery_verdict.description: The workflow template's own verdict (recovery and integrity only), kept when drills/lib/verdict.py re-derives `verdict` against the targets

verdict_reasons.description: Why the verdict is what it is: each failed objective, plus 'not assessed' notes for missing targets (drills/lib/verdict.py)

measured_rpo_records_lost_raw.description: A records-lost value that failed validation (negative, physically impossible), preserved for diagnosis instead of being dropped; see gap G15

classification_criteria_tripped.description: Which DORA Art. 18 RTS criteria tripped, from drills/lib/classify.py

manual_runbook_steps_required.description: Honest count of steps this drill could not automate — build-spec §6.6

t_notify_due_dora.description: t_classify + 4h, capped at t_detect + 24h unless classified later than that, in which case t_classify + 4h (Delegated Reg. (EU) 2025/301) — build-spec §6.4/§0.4

t_initial_submitted.description: When the DORA initial notification was actually submitted, if recorded. Later deadlines run from it

t_intermediate_submitted.description: When the (latest updated) DORA intermediate report was submitted, if recorded

t_notification_submitted_nis2.description: When the NIS2 incident notification was submitted, if recorded

t_intermediate_due_dora.description: 72h from submission of the initial notification (DORA Art. 19(4)(b); Delegated Reg. (EU) 2025/301; basis in drills/lib/clocks.py LEGAL_BASIS)

t_final_due_dora.description: One month from submission of the latest updated intermediate report (DORA Art. 19(4)(c); Delegated Reg. (EU) 2025/301)

t_notification_due_nis2.description: 72h from awareness (NIS2 Art. 23(4)(b)); t_detect stands in for awareness

t_final_due_nis2.description: One month from submission of the NIS2 incident notification (NIS2 Art. 23(4)(d))

deadline_basis.description: Whether later deadlines use recorded submission times or assume on-time submission (drills/lib/clocks.py)

artifacts.description: Paths/URIs to supporting evidence, e.g. s3://drills/<id>/velero.log
